implementation_issues.description: The paper reports quantile regression but does not state the fitted quantile, which is necessary to reproduce the Table 2 coefficients.
The source reports PCOST as the log of total assets but does not identify the logarithm base; the scale of this regressor is therefore not fully specified.
The paper manually matches 725 of 1,237 loans with missing ticker symbols to Compustat but gives no manual-match rules or record-level link identifiers.
The paper refers to Dichev and Skinner (2002) for effective loan-life adjustments for refinanced, rolled-over, amended, or replaced loans, but does not restate that procedure.

Loan-quarter dates must align with Compustat fiscal quarters for quarter-end current ratio, earnings-management measures, controls, and firm/quarter-year indicators; the exact loan-date to fiscal-quarter match rule is not stated.
DGDP is described only as the change in GDP from last year; country/series, level-versus-growth transformation, frequency, vintage, and alignment are not specified.
The paper uses the 2007 Dealscan release and a study-period Compustat vintage; current local tables have no confirmation that they reproduce those vintages or the paper’s 1992–2007 population.
Equation (1) estimates TAC_q/A_(q−1), while the printed Eq. (2) subtracts fitted scaled terms from TAC_q without displaying the same divisor; the paper does not reconcile AEMDA scaling.
Equation (6) scales CFO by prior-quarter assets, while the prose/appendix defines CFO as operating cash flow divided by total assets; REMCFO scaling is internally inconsistent.
The paper describes the abnormal production, expense, and CFO measures as residuals from cross-sectional equations but does not name the estimator for those residual-generating fits.
The paper reports a keyword search over SEC 10-Q, 10-K, and 8-K filings to screen FAR firms but does not give the full query, accession list, or coding resolution for hits.
